This directory contains the converted runtime model used for Elesis' combat animation.

The project operator confirmed on 2026-07-27 that permission had been obtained to redistribute the converted model as part of this mod. This permission record applies to the tracked Godot runtime GLB, its required textures, and their import metadata. The original BowlRoll archive, PMX source files, and Blender working files are not included in the repository.
